lead-v2-dark.svg: synthwerk-vision gives one image a label and the label's place in a topic tree (hut -> building -> building and structure). A label is a text, so a new label needs no training. It does one thing, on CPU, and does not want to talk about it.
lead-v2-light.svg: synthwerk-vision gives one image a label and the label's place in a topic tree (hut -> building -> building and structure). A label is a text, so a new label needs no training. It does one thing, on CPU, and does not want to talk about it.
what-v2-dark.svg: Open vocabulary: A label is a text, so a new label needs no training or new weights. A topic tree: Every label has a place: beagle -> dog -> mammal -> animal. Runs on CPU: ONNX Runtime, about 35 ms per image on an M-series Mac. No GPU, no external API. Eval gate: Scores 93.1 % root-topic accuracy on 58 frozen photos. CI fails below 90 %
what-v2-light.svg: Open vocabulary: A label is a text, so a new label needs no training or new weights. A topic tree: Every label has a place: beagle -> dog -> mammal -> animal. setup-v2-dark.svg: uv sync: Install runtime + dev dependencies from uv.lock. uv run python scripts/fetch_model.py: Both backends, pinned + SHA-256 verified (~1.5 GB). Or one: fetch_model.py siglip or fetch_model.py mobilenet. uv run uvicorn synthwerk_vision.main:create_app --factory --reload: Start the API. Open http://localhost:8000/docs. curl -F "image=@hut.jpg" http://localhost:8000/v1/classifications: Classify one image

startnotes-v2-dark.svg: Needs: uv (https://docs.astral.sh/uv/) and Python 3.14 (pyproject.toml: >=3.14,<3.15). First start: Embeds all label texts once (about 9 s on an M-series CPU) and caches them in models/label_cache/. Later starts take about 0.5 s
startnotes-v2-light.svg: Needs: uv (https://docs.astral.sh/uv/) and Python 3.14 (pyproject.toml: >=3.14,<3.15). First start: Embeds all label texts once (about 9 s on an M-series CPU) and caches them in models/label_cache/. Later starts take about 0.5 s
docker-v2-dark.svg: Terminal: # SigLIP (default) | $ docker build -t synthwerk-vision . | # MobileNet: 14 MB of weights | $ docker build --build-arg BACKEND=mobilenet -t synthwerk-vision:small . | $ docker run -p 8000:8000 -v synthwerk-vision-uploads:/data/uploads synthwerk-vision
docker-v2-light.svg: Terminal: # SigLIP (default) | $ docker build -t synthwerk-vision . | # MobileNet: 14 MB of weights | $ docker build --build-arg BACKEND=mobilenet -t synthwerk-vision:small . | $ docker run -p 8000:8000 -v synthwerk-vision-uploads:/data/uploads synthwerk-vision
how-v2-dark.svg: Scores: The model (SigLIP 2, ONNX, fp32) scores every label. The score of a topic is the sum of its labels. Response: The best label, its topic path, the top-k labels and the topics. Uncertain: uncertain turns true when the root topic score is too low. Read it before you trust the answer
how-v2-light.svg: Scores: The model (SigLIP 2, ONNX, fp32) scores every label. The score of a topic is the sum of its labels. Response: The best label, its topic path, the top-k labels and the topics. Uncertain: uncertain turns true when the root topic score is too low. Read it before you trust the answer
api-v2-dark.svg: GET /healthz: Liveness. No dependency checks. GET /readyz: Readiness. 503 until the model is loaded. POST /v1/classifications: Classify an image (not stored). POST /v1/images: Store an image, return its id. POST /v1/labels: Admin. Needs SYNTHWERK_VISION_ADMIN_TOKEN. GET /v1/labels: Admin. Needs SYNTHWERK_VISION_ADMIN_TOKEN. DELETE /v1/labels/{id}: Admin. Needs SYNTHWERK_VISION_ADMIN_TOKEN. POST /v1/feedback: Admin. Needs SYNTHWERK_VISION_ADMIN_TOKEN

backends-v2-dark.svg: siglip: Default. SigLIP 2 base/16, open vocabulary, ~1.5 GB of weights. mobilenet: MobileNetV2-12, 1000 ImageNet classes, 14 MB of weights

config-v2-dark.svg: SYNTHWERK_VISION_: Every setting is an env var with this prefix. See .env.example. SYNTHWERK_VISION_LOG_*: LOG_LEVEL (INFO) and LOG_FORMAT (json). Logs are JSON lines on stdout. OTEL_*: OpenTelemetry. Set OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT to export traces, metrics and logs. any other prefix: Env vars with any other prefix are ignored. Rename old names in every .env and deployment
